dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Pronounced concave curvature along the posterior margin, following a deep spline curve from the rounded apex to the sharpened posterior base point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological apex with a medium pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Shallow linear gradient approximately 25-30 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Elongated base-to-height ratio approximately 4:1, characterized by a long anterior dorsal ridge transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread light-toned punctate marks and irregular speckling distributed across the lateral surface of the fin and dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Significantly elongated anterior dorsal ridge that merges seamlessly into the leading edge of the dorsal fin.
